subject: SDK Interop governance gate review & runtime SLO alignment
messages:
From: Claire Simmons <claire@prometheus.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Hastings <mark.hastings@prometheus.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SDK interop governance gate - initial checklist

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. As we scoped the joint connector (Prometheus SDK <> Redwood runtime) the legal/commercial folks asked us to run this across your "interop governance gate" before we flip the integration to GA.

Attaching the interoperability checklist we use for all partner SDKs (interop-checklist.xlsx). High-level asks from our side:
- validation that the SDK preserves tracing headers (W3C traceparent) end-to-end when calling Redwood hosted and dedicated endpoints
- a short test report showing per-token latency distribution on a 512-token request shape for both hosted and dedicated variants
- confirmation of acceptable SLOs for cold start and steady-state for the dedicated pool

Can you confirm who on your side will own the validation and what acceptance criteria you require?

We'd prefer to have the gate closed in the next two business weeks if possible. Happy to run a joint test harness session.

Thanks,
Claire Simmons
Director of Integrations | Prometheus AI

Attachments: interop-checklist.xlsx
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Claire Simmons <claire@prometheus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SDK interop governance gate - initial checklist

Claire — thanks for the checklist and the clear asks. We'll own the validation on the Redwood side and propose the following approach:

1) Quick sync (30m) this week to align on the harness (we'll bring the test runner and a sample workload).
2) Redwood runs two validation passes: hosted API and Dedicated pool (matching your perf shape).
3) We provide a short report (pdf) with latency percentiles and tracing header inspection, plus a pass/fail against the acceptance criteria below.

Proposed acceptance criteria (can revise on the call):
- W3C traceparent present on >99.5% of requests (no header loss after retries/redirects)
- Dedicated steady-state p95 token latency <= 18ms for 512-token stepwise generation (measured across 1k requests)
- Cold-start recovery to steady-state within 1 minute with no SLA-impacting error spikes

Can Claire / Mark share a minimal test workload and sample trace ids you want us to look for? If you can share that today we can start an initial run tomorrow. I'm copying Jonas to set up the harness and capture criteria into a ticket.

Next steps: Jonas will schedule the sync; Marissa will handle the test artifacts and sign-off checklist.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference

Quick internal note —

Priyom, I agree with the acceptance criteria; small tweak on p95 token latency for dedicated: let's keep target <= 16ms if their 512-token workload is representative (we've been seeing headroom on our 80A pools). We'll offer a canary slot to Prometheus for the dedicated run (2h window) so they can re-run their harness against identical capacity.

Jonas — please prioritize a test runner and capture instructions (curl + sample payload and expected headers). Capture the harness as a reproducible script in INT-329. I'll draft the sign-off checklist entries and attach our confidentiality addendum if they need it.

Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SDK interop governance gate - initial checklist

Hi Claire — thanks, all. I've attached the initial test report from our first pass against the hosted endpoint (sdk-test-report.pdf). Summary:

- Tracing: W3C traceparent preserved for 99.9% of requests across 2k samples; header loss during a retry storm reproduced in a local failure mode but not in production.
- Latency (hosted): dedicated-case not applicable here — hosted API p95 token latency averaged ~22ms at 512-token shape (this is consistent with our hosted profile).
- Dedicated run: scheduled for Wed 18 Aug 09:00 PT in the canary slot (we'll provide connection details). Expecting to complete the dedicated validation within the same day; we'll post results to the Drive folder and tick the checklist items.

Notes / asks: please provide the sample trace ids you want inspected and a brief API key for the harness (we can rotate and delete after run).

Attachments: sdk-test-report.pdf

—Jonas
Senior Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
